name: atlas-workflow
description: Atlas workflow plugin for bounded local Codex work.

interface.longDescription: Adds Atlas workflow, task, office-hours, brainstorm, analyze, clarify, team, learning, design-review, worktree, and finish entrypoints as local plugin skills so `$atlas-workflow:cw`, `$atlas-workflow:task`, `$atlas-workflow:office-hours`, `$atlas-workflow:brainstorm`, `$atlas-workflow:analyze`, `$atlas-workflow:clarify`, `$atlas-workflow:team`, `$atlas-workflow:learn`, `$atlas-workflow:design-review`, `$atlas-workflow:worktree`, and `$atlas-workflow:finish` stay available even when custom slash prompts are unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Use $atlas-workflow:cw to start Atlas workflow for this request
Use $atlas-workflow:task to create or continue a bounded Atlas task
Use $atlas-workflow:office-hours to pressure-test early product, startup, side-project, or open-source ideas before design work
Use $atlas-workflow:brainstorm to turn rough ideas into design options, tradeoffs, and a recommended direction
Use $atlas-workflow:analyze for read-only cross-file evidence synthesis into analysis.md
Use $atlas-workflow:clarify to turn a chosen direction into context.md, decision.md, and spec.md with explicit execution boundaries
Use $atlas-workflow:team for multi-agent discussion, staffing, and promotion decisions
Use $atlas-workflow:learn to save a reusable Atlas lesson
Use $atlas-workflow:design-review to verify whether an implementation matches its design
Use $atlas-workflow:worktree when a task needs an isolated git worktree and a separate Compose test stack
Use $atlas-workflow:finish to verify completed branch work and wait for user confirmation before merge or cleanup
